columns.name: planet
columns.description: Planet name, as NASA writes it

columns.name: host_star
columns.description: Name of the star it orbits

columns.name: discovery_year
columns.description: Year the discovery was announced

columns.name: discovery_method
columns.description: How it was found

columns.name: discovery_facility
columns.description: Telescope or survey that found it

columns.name: type_in_this_atlas
columns.description: Size class used on this site

columns.name: distance_light_years
columns.description: Distance from the Sun

columns.name: radius_earth
columns.description: Radius in Earth radii (NASA value, may be calculated from mass)

columns.name: radius_estimated_from_mass
columns.description: yes if this site had to estimate the radius

columns.name: mass_earth
columns.description: Mass (or minimum mass) in Earth masses

columns.name: mass_radius_one_calculated
columns.description: yes if mass and radius fit a standard relation exactly, so one was probably calculated from the other

columns.name: orbital_period_days
columns.description: Length of a year in days

columns.name: semi_major_axis_au
columns.description: Orbit size in AU

columns.name: eccentricity
columns.description: Orbit shape, 0 is a circle

columns.name: equilibrium_temperature_k
columns.description: Temperature if it only absorbed and re-radiated starlight, in K

columns.name: starlight_earth
columns.description: Starlight received, Earth = 1

columns.name: star_temperature_k
columns.description: Star surface temperature in K

columns.name: star_radius_sun
columns.description: Star radius in Suns

columns.name: star_mass_sun
columns.description: Star mass in Suns

columns.name: ra_deg
columns.description: Right ascension in degrees

columns.name: dec_deg
columns.description: Declination in degrees

columns.name: status_debated
columns.description: yes if NASA flags the planet as controversial
